name: Artboard Mockups
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Artboard Mockups brings the Artboard Studio library, interactive editor and design tools into ChatGPT in one plugin. Create editable apparel, packaging and device mockups using your own images or videos. Change colors, backgrounds, artwork placement and canvas composition. Set up 3D device poses, keyframes and playback, or customize motion templates, then export the actual rendered design as a PNG or MP4. You can also reopen your saved Artboard projects and continue editing them by hand or through conversation.

Connect your Artboard account to access its projects and files. Available features and limits follow your existing Artboard plan. When an action is unavailable, Artboard explains the specific restriction and links to your normal Artboard account page. Purchases and checkout are not available inside this plugin.

Optional analytics help Artboard understand plugin activity and account-link visits and associate later website purchases with them. You can decline analytics or change your choice through Analytics & privacy in the Artboard menu. Plugin analytics exclude chat text, prompts, uploaded media and session replay.

For some follow-up requests, ChatGPT may require you to select Artboard Mockups again.
